items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: I was hearing at the same time Don Redmond and bands like that, Jimmy Lunsford.

ctx.x: I have to find some records about them. I guess I will. I think I may have one at one time or another, but I may have had one.

I was hearing at the same time Don Redmond and bands like that, Jimmy Lunsford. Not very often though, you see, because the radio didn't play at Jimmy Lunsford or Don Redmond as often as you could get a band like Paul Tremaine, except because of the hotel situation.
Did you have any ideal saxophone player that you felt influenced your style earlier? Who did people look up to in those times?
